limitations: Shared encoder and projection changes affect both score components; additive log-score deltas are not independent parameter causes.
An increased margin need not cross zero or change the global mode; a correct pair ranking need not cause a game win.
Outcome-selected pair populations are not representative of all actions; train/held comparisons are descriptive.
scope: Post-hoc descriptive differences between actual saved model endpoints on fixed exposed pairs; no hybrid model or parameter intervention.
